blocks.heading: Outbox
blocks.text: Outbox claim prevents duplicate vector publishing to Qdrant.

blocks.heading: Outbox
blocks.text: Outbox retry records temporary projection failures.

blocks.heading: Outbox
blocks.text: Outbox operation version fencing rejects stale vector events.

blocks.heading: Outbox
blocks.text: Outbox dead-letter state requires operator review.

blocks.heading: Inbox
blocks.text: Inbox claim handles user notification acknowledgement and delivery receipts.

blocks.heading: Inbox
blocks.text: Inbox retries do not publish vector events to Qdrant.

blocks.heading: Inbox
blocks.text: Inbox processing belongs to message delivery, not vector projection.

blocks.heading: Inbox
blocks.text: Inbox acknowledgements are unrelated to Qdrant payload indexes.

blocks.heading: Audit
blocks.text: Audit claim stores compliance review evidence for later inspection.

blocks.heading: Audit
blocks.text: Audit claim does not prevent duplicate vector publishing.

blocks.heading: Audit
blocks.text: Audit evidence may use retention rules separate from vector outbox.

blocks.heading: Audit
blocks.text: Audit claim is a legal evidence concept, not a Qdrant event claim.

blocks.heading: Qdrant
blocks.text: Qdrant payload indexes accelerate filtered vector search.

blocks.heading: Qdrant
blocks.text: Payload index creation is idempotent at collection startup.

blocks.heading: Qdrant
blocks.text: Qdrant vector distance does not replace PostgreSQL visibility checks.

blocks.heading: Qdrant
blocks.text: Missing payload indexes can increase latency on large collections.

blocks.heading: Tax
blocks.text: Synthetic invoice tax policy defines reporting fields for ordinary invoices.

blocks.heading: Tax
blocks.text: The tax policy does not mention Mars colony invoices.

blocks.heading: Tax
blocks.text: Invoice evidence retention differs from vector outbox processing.

blocks.heading: Tax
blocks.text: Tax reporting documents are distractors for technical RAG tests.

blocks.heading: Receipt
blocks.text: Receipt acknowledgement confirms a user saw a notification.

blocks.heading: Receipt
blocks.text: Receipt retry differs from vector outbox retry.

blocks.heading: Receipt
blocks.text: Receipt processing does not rebuild Qdrant points.

blocks.heading: Receipt
blocks.text: Receipt audit status should not be confused with dead-letter vector events.
